title: Argo Workflows Workflow Freshness SLA
app: Argo Workflows controller logs and the Argo API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=argo:workflow phase="Succeeded"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by workflow_template
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Argo Workflows workflow and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A workflow can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Argo Workflows.
implementation: Ingest Argo Workflows success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical workflow exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of workflow by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Argo Workflows has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
